Protein Food

Soy Curls

About This Entry

Soy curls are dehydrated whole soybean strips — chicken-like texture when rehydrated. BBQ and stir-fry sauces pair with medium reds and smoky whites.

Beginner Guide

Soak in hot water or broth; versatile shred after rehydration.
